描述_EN: an applied moulded decoration of prunus branches, a deer, a tiger and a dragon's head adorn the sides. its shape is derived from that of a rhinoceros horn. this cream-white cup was produced in dehua in south-east china, probably in a small family-run factory.
描述_ZN: 侧面有梅花、鹿、虎和龙首的模印装饰。 其形状来自于犀牛角的形状。 这个乳白色的杯子是在中国东南部的德化生产的，可能是在一个家庭式的小工厂。
